title: Interactive Choropleth Map: Sarasota County Census Tracts
text:
This interactive choropleth map displays the percentage of Hispanic or Latino residents (B03002_012E / B03002_001E) across all 122 census tracts in Sarasota County, Florida, using official 2024 U.S. Census TIGER/Line cartographic boundaries.

Hover over any census tract to see its population counts, 90% margin of error, and full racial/ethnic breakdown.
Switch basemaps in the top-right corner between Light Basemap, Street Map, and Satellite.

title: The Changing Face of America: Sarasota County, FL
text:
County-Wide Racial & Ethnic Composition
All categories below come from U.S. Census Bureau Table B03002 (Hispanic or Latino Origin by Race), ensuring that Hispanic/Latino residents and Non-Hispanic racial categories are strictly mutually exclusive and sum to 100.0% of Sarasota County’s population. See the Demographics page for detailed breakdowns.

title: About & Methodology
text: The Changing Face of America: Sarasota County, Florida is a data science project built with R, the tidyverse, Leaflet, Plotly, and Quarto. It examines the geographic distribution and demographic composition of Sarasota County residents using official U.S. Census Bureau data.

title: About & Methodology
text: The Changing Face of America: Sarasota County, Florida is a data science project built with R, the tidyverse, Leaflet, Plotly, and Quarto. It examines the geographic distribution and demographic composition of Sarasota County residents using official U.S. Census Bureau data.

title: About & Methodology
text:
Official Data Sources

U.S. Census Bureau — 2020–2024 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Estimates

Table B03002 (Hispanic or Latino Origin by Race): Provides population counts and 90% margins of error for Sarasota County (FIPS 12115) and all census tracts within the county.
Retrieved via tidycensus / the official U.S. Census Bureau API (data.census.gov/api/access/data/table?id=ACSDT5Y2024.B03002).

U.S. Census Bureau — 2024 TIGER/Line Cartographic Boundary Shapefiles

Retrieved via the tigris R package (tigris::tracts(state = "FL", county = "Sarasota", year = 2024, cb = TRUE)) and projected to WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) for interactive mapping.

title: About & Methodology
text:
Methodology & Mutually Exclusive Categories
To avoid overlapping racial and ethnic categories, all percentages are computed from Table B03002 using the total population denominator (B03002_001E = 459,547):
\[\text{Percentage in Group } i = \frac{\text{Estimate}_i}{\text{Total Population (B03002\_001E)}} \times 100\]








Category

B03002_009E
Non-Hispanic Multiracial



Because these eight sub-populations partition the total population (B03002_001E) without overlap, their counts sum exactly to 459,547 (100.00%).

title: About & Methodology
text:
Reproducible Project Structure

download_data.R: Downloads official 2024 ACS 5-year estimates and 2024 TIGER/Line census tract geometries for Sarasota County, saving them as .rds files in data/.
analysis.R: Cleans the data, validates mutually exclusive sums, calculates tract-level percentages, and defines the interactive leaflet map and plotly chart builders.
index.qmd, map.qmd, demographics.qmd, about.qmd: Quarto pages forming the website.

title: Demographics of Sarasota County, Florida
text:
In U.S. Census data, Hispanic or Latino origin is measured separately from race, meaning that simply adding race counts from Table B02001 to Hispanic counts from Table B03003 double-counts Hispanic residents and produces percentages exceeding 100%.
To ensure strictly mutually exclusive categories that sum to 100.00%, this analysis uses ACS Table B03002 (Hispanic or Latino Origin by Race):

Hispanic or Latino (Any Race): B03002_012E (48,971 residents, 10.66%)
Non-Hispanic Racial Groups: B03002_003E through B03002_009E (410,576 residents, 89.34%)
